name: Mana Wastes Medic
requirements: Alchemist healers who hail from the Mana Wastes or who have lived there for at least 1 year
text: After witnessing a terrible disaster result from an attempt at magical healing in the Mana Wastes, you are careful and methodical when crafting your own healing tinctures. The amount of hit points restored by your Heal checks to treat deadly wounds and your extracts of the healing subschool is increased by 1.
